column1: # #1023 A/B shared oracle for input-backed host tokens of another kind, measured with Java (NamedCapture /
# SemanticPredicateParser / CaptureBoundaryParser.input), columns and entries as full.tsv. vci / mi / vmi = a host that
# reads 'c' at the consumed cursor, publishes only its own token of the input slice in the virtualTokenConsumed /
# matchOnly / virtualTokenMatchOnly kind and consumes 1 (Java: peek + addToken + consume(1); Rust: a native custom
# that calls add_token_node(.., Input) and advance(1)). Its kind is independent of its source: a collector excludes it
# as it excludes vc, and a consumed-kind token before it (Optional over MatchOnly, Rule, a Choice that selected
# MatchOnly or such a host, whose own token is "" at the cursor) still starts the collection.
# Other shapes as full.tsv (z = a word that does not match).
